result:
My verdict is **PASS** for DG4 round 10 on candidate `sha256:f38274cb…17ccc6` (source `e70ac02`, freeze `01a801e`). I raised **no new findings** and wrote no sidecar.

**What I checked this round**
- **Candidate identity:** confirmed on a complete clone, at the freeze and at the source, and on the working tree, at the start and the end: 1475 files and the same ID every time. Two run-record commits from the other reviewers landed during my run, all under `docs/delivery`. I checked only their paths, not their content.
- **Diff scope:** the product diff from `f2ae717` is exactly the nine FE-R11 and BE-R7 files. Everything else is byte-identical to the code I reviewed in full in round 7.
- **FE-R11 (F-DG4-160 and the sweep):**
  - The new status hint and the planned-area texts are pinned word for word in English and Arabic.
  - Restoring the old round-9 texts makes 14 of 49 tests fail.
  - The round-9 audit's reproduction of F-DG4-160 no longer reproduces.
  - My own probe on the real stack shows the texts are true:
    - the Closure page the hint points to opens;
    - every sub-entry listed under the four planned areas opens a working transformation screen.
  - The probe passes in both languages and both locale settings, with no accessibility issues, at 390 px and at 200 % text.
- **BE-R7 (A08 G6 fingerprint):**
  - The narrowed check still asserts it covers `stages.json`, `findings.json`, `requirements.csv` and a `gates/DGx.json`.
  - My mutants each make exactly the G6 test fail: changing stages, requirements or findings, adding `gates/DG7.json`, or adding a review.
  - A write to `candidates/` passes, which is by design.
  - No product code writes under `docs/delivery`, so the narrowing loses nothing the requirement covers.
- **Runs:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Unit tests, 4 runs (Node 22 and 24, both locale settings), inside the load limit (max 6.91) | All exit 0: 1589 / 1358 / 259 + 2 skipped by design |
| Full integration, once | 209 files, 1984/1984, max load 6.25 |
| `tests/qa` alone | 172/172 |
| REQ-DLV-036 (A04, A09, A10, A11) | 85/85 |
| Changed e2e specs (journeys, p3-seams), English and Arabic, accessibility checked | 24/24 in each locale setting, 0 accessibility violations |
| Root acceptance specs (`e2e/`) | 14/14 in each locale setting |
| Static checks | 7/7 pass |
| Validators (DG3, DG2, DG1 historical, register, pipeline) | 10/10 pass |
| Register | 137/137 rows IMPLEMENTED |

- **Decisions:** D-137, D-138 and D-139 are accurate.
  - My own sweep found some fallback texts not named one by one in the FE-R11 table, such as "not listed in this release" and "cannot be evaluated in this release". None claims a delivered feature is missing.
  - D-137 also gives two key names slightly wrong: `nav.portfolioPlanned` should be `nav.entry.portfolioPlanned`, and `transformations.laterStage` should be `transformations.workspace.laterStage`.
  - I recorded both as observations, not findings.

**Disclosed in the record**
- My first unit series ran above the load limit (max 11.82), partly because my own validators overlapped it. All four runs passed, but I re-ran the series and used only the second one.
- Four of my own harness mistakes are kept as evidence and not used as results:
  - two invalid A08 mutant attempts: a test filter that skipped the setup tests, then an overlap with a run I had failed to stop;
  - a too-broad e2e filter that picked up old probe files;
  - a first probe revision whose sub-entry check was too weak.

  None of them involved the product.
- Harmless warnings in the logs:
  - React duplicate-key warnings from passing tests;
  - error-path stdout from passing integration tests;
  - npm config warnings in the e2e logs;
  - Vite's chunk-size advisory in the build.

**Not re-run this round:** the full product e2e suite, the read-only auditor-role pass, the 390 px / 200 % checks on all P4 screens, and the second integration run. These are carried forward from round 7 on identical code, and the record says so in each check.

**Files written:**
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-10/qa-verifier.json` (validates against the review schema with 0 errors; all 101 evidence paths exist)
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-10/qa-verifier.md` (narrative)
- evidence in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-10/`
- my probe spec in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-10/e2e/zz-qa-r10-fe-r11.spec.ts`

The disposable clones and scratch files have been removed. I decided no product gate (G1–G6), and product G6 never implies DG7.
